title: GOSSIP AND FAILURE DETECTION
subtitle: Who is alive, with no central server, when silence can mean dead, slow or partitioned.
footer: System Design, Step by Step · core concepts

blocks.text: One random ping per interval; indirect probes through other nodes before suspicion; a grace period to refute.
Tell a few random peers each round: news reaches N nodes in ~log N rounds with constant work per node.

items: Short: fast detection, false alarms in GC pauses
Long: requests keep going to dead nodes
Phi accrual: suspicion level from heartbeat history
Cheap actions at low suspicion, data movement only at high
Never elect leaders or take locks by gossip: use consensus

blocks.text: "Nodes gossip membership every second, so news reaches 500 nodes in about 9 rounds. Phi accrual stops routing reads to a suspect node quickly, but re-replication waits minutes, so a GC pause never moves terabytes."
